test_gtn_equal: test two gtn Graph objects for structural equality including nodes, arcs, labels, and weights
test_gtn_isomorphic: test whether two gtn Graph objects are structurally isomorphic regardless of node ordering
test_gtn_loadtxt: test loading a gtn Graph from a text file using gtn.loadtxt and verify correctness
test_gtn_savetxt: test saving a gtn Graph to a text file using gtn.savetxt and verify output format
test_gtn_loadsave: test binary serialization of a gtn Graph using gtn.save and gtn.load round-trip
